Swivel Nozzle · Needle Bearing Parts

This page brings together swivel nozzles (SNA·SNM·SNPT series), which are lubrication fittings for machining, and the seals and circlips (OS·DS, WR·AR) used together with needle bearings.

* Pillow balls and L-balls used to be listed on this page, but it was found that the pillow ball (PB) duplicated the same spec as PB (JS) on the Spherical Plain Bearing page, and the PHS·POS·PHSA series duplicated the same spec as the Rod End Bearing page, so they have been removed. L-balls have been moved to the Link Ball · L-Ball page.

You can search by entering just part of the model number or dimensions.
